subject: Fortnightly exec snapshot — wins, risks, asks (QBR week prep)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fortnightly exec snapshot — wins, risks, asks (QBR week prep)

Team — sending the condensed snapshot for this fortnight and actions we need before the QBR. TL;DR: good momentum on Dedicated capacity pilot, one active risk on the Acme Health onboarding (security items), and two asks for leadership. Please review and flag any additional blockers.

Wins:
- Dedicated pilot (cluster-ded-3) passed 72-hour soak: sustained 95 p99 latency under expected load. Metrics attached (QBR_onepager_v2.pdf).
- Model catalog rollout: 3 curated model profiles now live for streaming API; initial cost vs latency shows ~18% token-cost improvement for search workloads.

Risks / Concerns:
- Acme Health security questionnaire: they requested SOC2 evidence + network topology review. Partner team estimates a 10 business day turnaround for the missing items; this could delay their production cutover and impact projected revenue for the quarter. (Amy Patel is copied in subsequent threads).
- Autoscaler corner-case: we observed a small window where burst scale-down reclaimed KV cache before draining requests — reproducible in staging under sustained sub-second bursts. Engineering has a mitigation plan but needs a config freeze window to deploy the fix.

Asks (Action):
1) Laura / Jonas — approve a 48-hour config freeze window next week to deploy the autoscaler mitigation (propose Tue 6/8 01:00-05:00 PT). I’ll coordinate rollback playbook.
2) Karthik — please confirm if we can reallocate two s-rep roles from the Marketplace project to expedite the Acme security items (10 business days target).

Notes & links:
- Attached: QBR_onepager_v2.pdf (one-pager + key metrics), deployment-runbook-notes.md (runbook stub).
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Prep-Redwood

Thanks — I’ll consolidate responses into the QBR pack by EOD Monday.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Ops Enablement | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Fortnightly exec snapshot — wins, risks, asks (QBR week prep)

Thanks Tessa — solid update and appreciated brevity.
- I approve the 48-hour config freeze window in principle. Jonas, please confirm whether Tue 6/8 01:00-05:00 PT works for platform operations. If not, propose an alternate 4-hour window early next week.
- On Acme: prioritize the SOC2 evidence thread. If we need help pulling artifacts, ask Security to run an expedited extraction.

One quick ask from me: include a single-slide callout in the QBR pack about the Dedicated pilot performance vs. baseline (p95/p99 + cost delta). I’ll sign off on the slide once it’s drafted.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 10:16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fortnightly exec snapshot — wins, risks, asks (QBR week prep)

Tessa / Laura — quick feasibility note on the Acme ask. We can reassign the two s-rep engineers from Marketplace but that will slip Marketplace milestone M3 by two weeks unless we push more backlog out. I'll need explicit leadership sign-off to re-prioritize.

Proposed compromise: temporarily reassign one s-rep full-time for the next 10 business days, and have a contractor handle the Marketplace backfill. That minimizes schedule slip and gives Acme the priority artifact handling.

Karthik
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fortnightly exec snapshot — wins, risks, asks (QBR week prep)

Karthik — noted and thank you for the trade-off proposal. Security is already working with the Acme request; two clarifications: 
1) The SOC2 artifacts we need to produce are scoped (log retention table + access lists). Security can extract logs for the last 90 days but will need a teammate to validate the network topology diagram before we hand it off to Acme.
2) On the autoscaler mitigation: ops tested the patch in staging; it requires a short window to flip feature flags and validate no cache evictions. Tue 6/8 01:00-05:00 PT is acceptable but we should aim for the earlier part of that window (01:00-03:00 PT) for smoke validation.

If leadership approves the single s-rep reassign + contractor backfill, Security and Ops can meet the 10-business-day target for Acme artifacts (assuming no additional external asks).

— Soojin
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fortnightly exec snapshot — wins, risks, asks (QBR week prep)

Thanks all — summary / final asks and owners: 

1) Config freeze window: Approved for Tue 6/8 01:00-03:00 PT (Laura / Jonas). Tessa to own deployment runway and rollback playbook. Attachment: deployment-runbook-notes.md (included).
2) Acme artifact turnaround: Approve Karthik’s compromise — reassign one s-rep + contractor backfill. Karthik to confirm contractor onboarding by EOD Tue. Security (Soojin) to own extraction and network diagram validation. Target: deliver artifacts to Acme by Fri 6/18 (10 business days).
3) QBR slide: Laura to sign off on the Dedicated pilot performance slide; Tessa to draft and send by EOD Wed. (See QBR_onepager_v2.pdf for metrics).

External touchpoint: Amy (Acme) — we will follow up directly from the security thread with the artifact ETA and a short meeting invite for alignment. Tessa will coordinate docs and DocuSign for any needed acknowledgements.

Open items: Jonas — please confirm there are no conflicts with Marketplace changes during the freeze window; Karthik — confirm contractor details.

I'll incorporate these items into the QBR pack and circulate the deck for final review on Thursday.

— Tessa
thread_summary: Fortnightly exec snapshot from Tessa: Dedicated pilot passed soak, Acme Health security artifacts are a risk, autoscaler mitigation needs a brief config freeze. Leadership approved a reduced freeze window and a partial reassign of engineering resources; owners assigned for QBR deliverables and artifact turnaround.
